execution.PlannedWork: The Work declared for one execution.

Dependency.description: One Work whose completion enables another Work.

execution.Dependencies: The dependency graph of one execution.
execution.TerminalWork: The Work with no dependent Work.

ExecutionPlan.description: The Work and Dependencies declared for one execution.
ExecutionPlan.derivation: Work that is not the source of a Dependency.

Activation.description: Work enabled once by its triggering occurrences.

Completion.description: The occurrence and outcome of performed Work.

execution.Completions: The completed Work of one execution.

ExecutionStatusKind.value: Work is active and awaiting Completion.
No Work is active and terminal Work remains incomplete.

Active.description: Work is active and awaiting Completion.

Blocked.description: No Work is active and terminal Work remains incomplete.

execution.ExecutionStatus: The present disposition of an execution.

ExecutionKind.value: An execution constructed from its triggering occurrence.
An execution reconstructed by one Work Completion.

ExecutionOrigin.description: An execution constructed from its triggering occurrence.
ExecutionOrigin.derivation: Planned Work without prerequisites, enabled by trigger.
Every Activation constructed for this execution.
Active when activated Work awaits Completion; otherwise blocked.

ExecutionProgression.description: An execution reconstructed by one Work Completion.
ExecutionProgression.derivation: The plan established at the origin.
The occurrence that established the execution.
Prior Completions followed by completion when it is distinct and carries an Activation from this execution or external prerequisite Work.
Previously inactive Work whose prerequisites have completed.
Finished when every terminal Work completed; active while activated Work awaits Completion; otherwise blocked.

execution.Execution: The recursively constructed history of one event-driven execution.
execution.law: A trigger constructs an ExecutionOrigin; each Completion constructs one ExecutionProgression.
Construction derives each Work Activation once, after every prerequisite Work has a Completion.
A repeated Completion or a Completion for unactivated planned Work does not alter execution facts.
EX imports no event transport; a transport delivers constructed Events and publishes derived Activations.
